| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "And-I-will-not-hide My-face anymore from-them, when I-pour-out My-Spirit upon the-house-of Israel," declares the-Lord YHWH. |
| LOGOS | "And I will not hide My face anymore from them, when I pour out My Spirit upon the house of Israel, declares the Lord GOD." |
